## Immediate Containment



- [ ] Affected deployment or release path stopped if required

- [ ] Secret owner identified

- [ ] Exposed credential revoked at source

- [ ] Replacement credential created with least privilege



## GitHub Update



- [ ] Repository secret updated

- [ ] Environment secret updated if applicable

- [ ] Workflow rerun

- [ ] Logs checked for accidental exposure

- [ ] Artifacts checked for accidental exposure



## Verification



- [ ] Gitleaks passes

- [ ] Relevant workflow passes

- [ ] No real secret value appears in code, logs, issues, or artifacts
